about: A Go library for making and editing PDF files, from page layout to forms and signatures.

prs.title: Text extraction reads text inside templates
prs.broken: Pulling text out of a page skipped anything inside an embedded template, so some pages came out empty.
prs.changed: Text extraction now follows those templates and reads their text too.
prs.matters: Pages built from templates, like many saved by macOS, give back all their text.

prs.title: Optimizing a PDF no longer loses its text
prs.broken: Shrinking some PDFs pointed fonts at the wrong parts of the file, so text disappeared from the result.
prs.changed: Shared parts of the file are now renumbered once, so every font keeps pointing at the right place.
prs.matters: Optimized PDFs look the same as the originals.
